product.seoTitle: Hi-Seas Fluorocarbon 25 lb Diameter & Capacity | ReelCalc
product.metaDescription: Check the catalog-listed Hi-Seas CFC-F200-25 mainline: 25 lb, .018 inch / .45 mm and 200 yards. Compare reel capacity with explicit source and availability limits.
product.quickSummary: Hi-Seas 100% Fluorocarbon Line is the CFC-F200 mainline family, distinct from the brand's leader-only and coated lines. This limited chart covers the catalog-listed 25 lb Clear filler spool: .018 inch / .45 mm and 200 yards, confirmed by its exact package photo. Retail availability is not verified.
product.suitabilitySummary: The verified 25 lb size is a substantial .45 mm line, so choose it for a tackle and presentation requirement, not merely because a reel can hold it. Consider spool diameter, rod rating and lure weight before selecting a full fluorocarbon fill. The manufacturer also describes terminal-leader use, but a short leader ahead of braid and fluorocarbon carried as the working mainline are different plans.
strengthGuide: Only 25 lb is included in this chart. Its .018-inch / .45-mm pair appears in the official mainline catalog row and on the exact CFC-F200-25 package; other pound tests must not inherit this diameter.

Choose this physical size only where the rod, hook or lure and fishing conditions justify it. A 25 lb label is not a drag setting or proof that thick fluorocarbon will handle comfortably on a small spinning spool.
The 200-yard label is supplied length. For a shorter working section, retain enough for casts, expected runs and trimming before filling unused volume with backing.
product.fitTitle: When the CFC-F200 package fits the plan
product.bestFit: A source-documented option when you specifically need the 25 lb Clear Hi-Seas mainline and a 200-yard filler spool. The manufacturer describes a castable running line made from pure PVDF; this page does not claim a hands-on casting or abrasion comparison.
product.tradeoff: The live 25 lb shop URL is unavailable even though the linked catalog and exact package photo establish its specification. Confirm the CFC-F200-25 package and availability before buying. A capacity estimate does not establish how comfortably this diameter will handle on your reel.
product.chartNote: One verified strength: Clear CFC-F200-25, 25 lb, .018 inch / .45 mm, 200 yards. The 10/12/15/20 lb entries remain excluded because exact shop data conflicts with catalog/photo evidence. A 30 lb CFC-F200 source is not established.
product.chartCaption: Catalog-listed CFC-F200-25 specification and package length. Current retail availability is not verified.
product.diameterNote: The catalog and exact 25 lb package independently publish .018 inch and .45 mm. These are rounded source labels, not exact arithmetic conversions. Package calculations use 200 yards only; the catalog says 182 m and the photo 183 m, so neither metric label is treated as an exact conversion.

spoolingGuide.title: Match the CFC-F200-25 label
spoolingGuide.text: Confirm 25 lb Clear 100% Fluorocarbon Line and 200 yards. A Hi-Seas leader spool, Quattro product or fluorocarbon-coated Grand Slam line is not the same package.

spoolingGuide.title: Choose the useful working length
spoolingGuide.text: Compare the reel's capacity at .018 inch with the 200-yard supply. A deliberate working section can sit over backing, with its junction below the line needed for normal casts and fish runs.

spoolingGuide.title: Check handling while filling
spoolingGuide.text: Use steady winding tension and the reel maker's fill clearance. Stop short of overfilling and check line handling; unused supply is preferable to forcing the whole package onto a smaller spool.

product.reelcalcNote: Use the specific 25 lb CFC-F200 mainline diameter for this estimate. A missing strength in this limited chart is not permission to substitute another Hi-Seas formulation.

manufacturerFacts.label: Exact identity
manufacturerFacts.text: The official mainline catalog lists CFC-F200-25 as Clear 100% Fluorocarbon Line in a filler spool, not leader-only stock.

manufacturerFacts.label: Matching package evidence
manufacturerFacts.text: The exact manufacturer photo prints 25 lb, .018 inch, .45 mm, 200 yards and CFC-F200-25.

setupComparison.title: Working mainline or terminal section?
setupComparison.leftText: Plan capacity from the .018-inch mainline diameter. A longer working fill may need most of the package; allow for trimming rather than assuming every supplied yard is usable.
setupComparison.rightText: The manufacturer also describes terminal-leader use. Choose that section's length and connection separately; it does not replace the reel's mainline or backing calculation.

productGuidance: Confirm CFC-F200-25, Clear and 200 yards on the package before purchase; current retail availability has not been established.
Keep the .45 mm diameter in view when comparing line handling and capacity with thinner fluorocarbon choices.
Do not infer missing tests from this one-row chart. Conflicting specifications remain excluded until the manufacturer clarifies them.
product.recommendationIntro: Evaluate this 25 lb fluorocarbon only after checking tackle and presentation needs. The example demonstrates volume on a round baitcaster, not a universal reel or technique recommendation.

faqs.question: Why does this chart show only 25 lb?
faqs.answer: The exact CFC-F200-25 catalog row and package photo agree. Other strengths either have conflicting manufacturer specifications or lack an exact verified mainline source, so they are not included.

faqs.question: Is the 25 lb package available to buy now?
faqs.answer: Stock was not verified. AFW still links the catalog containing this SKU, but its individual shop URL returns 404. Confirm the exact package with a seller before ordering.

faqs.question: Is this Hi-Seas fluorocarbon leader?
faqs.answer: It is the 200-yard CFC-F200 mainline filler spool. The manufacturer also describes using the material for terminal leaders, but separate Hi-Seas leader products do not supply the specifications for this chart.

faqs.question: Will one 200-yard spool fill my reel?
faqs.answer: Compare the exact reel capacity at .018 inch with the supplied length. A short working section may leave room for backing, while a larger reel may need more than one package.

faqs.question: Should I use the 182 m or 183 m label?
faqs.answer: Use the agreed 200-yard package length. That converts to 182.88 m, approximately 183 m. The catalog instead prints 182 m; this guide preserves that discrepancy and does not use either companion label to redefine the supplied yardage.
